product_summary: Website shreenathfinechem.com (Nagpur, Maharashtra; plant at Village Malegaon, Tahsil Saoner, Dist. Nagpur 441107; HO Bezonebagh, Nagpur 440014) presents itself as a manufacturer and exporter of manganese-based inorganic chemicals since 2008. Real product lines listed on the Products page: (1) Manganese Oxide (MnO) in four grades — Feed Grade, Chemical Grade, Welding Grade, Battery Grade; (2) Manganese Di-Oxide (MnO2) — Chemical Grade, High Purity, Granules; (3) Manganese Tetra-Oxide (Mn3O4) — Brick Colouring Grade, Oil Drilling Grade. Declared applications: animal feed additive, water treatment, brick colouring, oil drilling muds, welding electrodes, ferrites/pigments/catalysts, ceramics, metallurgy (flux in steelmaking), batteries. All three core products are manganese oxides, which fall squarely in HS 2820 — 'Manganese oxides' (2820.10 manganese dioxide; 2820.90 other, i.e. MnO and Mn3O4). The declared code 282090 is therefore the correct HS-6 heading for the bulk of the range.
role_hint: manufacturer (site claims in-house production and 'Built-In Engineering & Manufacturing'; no trader/intermediary signs found on the site — no third-party brand resale, no 'authorised dealer' language). Claim of manufacturing is per company website only, not corroborated by any customs line in this review.
comment: HS-6 mapping: declared 282090 = 'Manganese oxides, other than manganese dioxide' — matches MnO and Mn3O4 exactly, and matches the MnO2 line only at the 4-digit level (2820), since MnO2 has its own subheading 2820.10. Verdict: exact for the declared heading; recommend splitting the declaration into 282010 (MnO2 grades: Chemical, High Purity, Granules) and 282090 (MnO feed/chemical/welding/battery grades and Mn3O4 brick-colouring/oil-drilling grades) so that the customs line reflects the actual product mix. Industry label 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is a misclassification: the company is an inorganic/specialty chemicals manufacturer (HS chapter 28), not a mining or metallurgical producer — metallurgy appears only as an end-use application (MnO as steelmaking flux). No mining licences, ore extraction or metal products are shown on the site. Product lines missing from the declaration: none of significance — the site's entire range is manganese oxides; however the grade-level split (feed grade, welding grade, battery grade, oil-drilling grade) is not reflected in a single 282090 code. Trader signs: none observed. Per project rules, all product claims here are website-sourced and are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs/B-L line was available in this review to corroborate any specific grade or shipment. No registry, revenue or shipment-volume research was performed (out of scope for this role). Sources: https://www.shreenathfinechem.com/ and https://www.shreenathfinechem.com/products/ (both read successfully).
